summary: A first-time canvasser begins a shift with a door shut in their face.
realLife: owner, Nov 14: An abrupt rejection can be someone’s first experience knocking on doors.
inGame: needs: combine a first-outing fact with the resident ending the encounter.
gates: This is the canvasser’s first outing.

turns.what: The resident opens the door long enough to ask who sent the canvasser.
turns.pulledBy: The resident recognizes the group on the volunteer's card.
turns.writesBack: The first stop yields a brief conversation.
